pages.title: Cool It, Bear
pages.text: Pacify a Psycho Bear using Psycho Berry Ice Cream.

pages.title: Cool It, Bear
pages.text: Psycho Berry sprouts support growing future treats at home and the painting commemorates the peaceful encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The bear likes Psycho Berries, but this interaction specifically uses the ice cream. Keep a safe retreat and observe native pacification; killing it is unnecessary.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Offer Psycho Ice Cream to pacify a Psycho Bear, or defeat one for its claws. Native advancement text explicitly specifies the ice cream; the guide identifies Psycho Berries as its favorite food.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Craft all three Ice Cream types and a full Frostbite armor set. Native milestones separate cooking collection from protective equipment progression.
